features.title: Everything you need to stay in control of what you eat

recognize.title: Recognize meals from a photo
recognize.text: Snap or pick a photo and FoodFen lists the ingredients with estimated portions. You can adjust them before saving.

goals.title: A diary built around your goals
goals.text: Set calorie and macro targets and see how much you have left each day.

streaks.title: Streaks and quests
streaks.text: Keep your logging streak, complete weekly quests and trade coins for Premium days.

insights.title: Insights and an AI assistant
insights.text: Follow your weight trend and weekly calories, then ask the AI assistant about your own meals.

capture.text: Snap your meal or pick an existing photo. You can also type or say the dish name.
capture.alt: Overhead view of a salmon rice bowl

confirm.text: Review the ingredient list, adjust portions if needed, then save it to your diary.
confirm.alt: Plate of salmon, green beans and grains

track.text: Compare with your goals for the day and see the trend across the week.
track.alt: Breakfast table with oatmeal and fruit

premium.title: Free to start. Premium when you need more.

perks.coins: Trade the coins you earn for Premium days

free.a: Yes. Logging meals and photo recognition are free. Premium unlocks more advanced features.

accuracy.q: How accurate is the food recognition?
accuracy.a: Results are estimates. You can always adjust the ingredients and portions before saving.

privacy.a: Your weight and food diary belong to your account and are never shown to anyone else.

mobile.q: Can I use it on my phone?
mobile.a: Yes. FoodFen has iOS and Android apps that sync with the web version.
